data.gender_notes: Arul is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings joy and bliss. Derived from the Tamil word 'Arulvai' meaning 'blissful'. The name Arul carries the meaning “Bliss, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Arul usually hope their child will grow to embody bliss, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name bestowed upon those who bring light, joy and bliss to others.
data.etymology: Arul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bliss, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
